paragraphs: A Jaguar AJ16 engine rebuild starts from £3,200.

A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Jaguar already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ16 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the condition risk a used unit carries. Enter your reg below and we'll talk you through both options honestly.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.
Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers.

faqLeft.q: What is the Jaguar AJ16 engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ16 is Jaguar's 4.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, produced from 1994 to 1997. It was the final iteration of Jaguar's classic straight-six and was fitted exclusively to the XJ X300 generation.

faqLeft.q: Which Jaguar models use the AJ16?
faqLeft.a: The AJ16 was used exclusively in the XJ X300 generation (1994–1997) as the XJ6 variant.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar AJ16 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ16 rebuilds for the XJ X300, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: Is the AJ16 a reliable engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ16 is a robust, well-regarded engine with no widely-reported catastrophic issue pattern. It remains one of the most respected powerplants from the Ford-era Jaguar transition.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Jaguar AJ16 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ16 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ16 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the condition risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
